fixes.explanation: Right on the money, friend. Paul says "…God’s kindness leads you to repentance?" So the kindness isn't just there to be enjoyed. It's pointing somewhere, and that somewhere is turning around. I've been on the receiving end of that kindness myself, and it got me out of the back of a junk drawer.

That's the word, friend. Paul says the hard and unrepentant heart is "…storing up wrath against yourself for the day of wrath…" The verse says the storing is something this person is doing, and it points to the day when God's righteous judgment will be revealed. That's a heavy line, so let's let it sit for a second.

Nice try, friend, but the verse doesn't go there. Paul says "…God does not show favoritism." (Romans 2:11). Nothing in the passage mentions the Jews getting extra time. The reason he gives is that God shows no favoritism.

Interesting guess, friend, but that's not what Paul says. He says these Gentiles do not have the law, and that the work of the law is written on their hearts (Romans 2:15). Elders don't come up in the verse at all. The evidence he points to is on the inside.

Good thinking, friend, but angels aren't what Paul names here. He says God will judge men's secrets "…through Christ Jesus, as proclaimed by my gospel." Angels don't come up in the verse. The name in it is Jesus.
